### COPF: An Online Framework for Deployment-Stable Counterfactual Fairness in Evolving Graphs

::: {.paper-authors}
**Sheng’en Li**, Dongmian Zou
:::

An online framework combining counterfactual estimation, outcome-indistinguishability auditing, and fairness control for evolving-graph recommendation.

### Enhancing Fairness in Autoencoders for Node-Level Graph Anomaly Detection

::: {.paper-authors}
Shoju Wang\*, Yuchen Song\*, **Sheng’en Li**\*
:::

A fairness-aware graph autoencoder for node-level anomaly detection, with a counterfactual fairness objective based on causal interventions.

[Read paper ↗](https://arxiv.org/abs/2508.10785){.text-link}

### COMET: Counterfactual Moment Auditing under Weak Overlap and Dependent Feedback

::: {.paper-authors}
**Sheng’en Li**\* et al.
:::

Certifying counterfactual moments under weak overlap, heavy-tailed outcomes, graph–time dependence, and distribution drift, with subgroup discovery and certificate-guided policy repair.

::: {.paper-meta}

### Auditing and Refining Partial-Physics Models: Scaffold Adequacy, Local Identifiability and ECG-Based Electrolyte Inference

::: {.paper-authors}
Juntang Wang\*, **Sheng’en Li**\*, Yihan Wang\*, Jiayu Gao\*, Duanduan Wang\*, Dongmian Zou, Shixin Xu
:::

Separating scaffold adequacy from inverse identifiability to audit and refine partial-physics models for ECG-based electrolyte inference.
